items.html: Correction 11 is an additional correction on the aforementioned hairs of correction 10, for besides their being there in that place — for that is why it is called correction 10 — there is yet another correction added in them: that they are all weighed as one, and equal in one extension, they do not come out one from the other, and they are all of one measure, equal in their length. And it is found that in these very hairs there are two corrections.
